verdict.rationale: The evidence covers installation paths: a marketplace install, copying the skill folder, uploading a zip, or running tools/package_skill.py. It also notes the skill is a folder with a SKILL.md plus Python tools. None of it documents a way to list what the skill will add before installing, such as a file manifest or contents preview, or any review step for reading every installed file. Being able to read the files only comes from the open Agent Skills folder format and GitHub hosting, which are host-platform properties rather than a capability of this skill, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward
